messages:
Alex: Hey @Dmitri, we got a partial RMA notice but the AWB/manifest wasn't attached. eu-west provisioning shows we lose 8 H100s if replacements don't arrive — that will impact scheduled rollouts this week. Can you share AWB + ETA?

Dmitri (Vendor): Sorry, Alex — split shipment. AWB for batch A attached below. Batch B still with customs inspection, no AWB yet.

Dmitri (Vendor): ```AWB: HX1234567890, HX1234567891
Manifest ref: MAN-8742
Inspection ref: CN-9933```

Maria: @Dmitri can you push photos of packaging/serial list for the inspected units? customs is asking for serials to clear. If we can get PDF manifest + photos today we can try expedite.

Dmitri (Vendor): Uploading photos in 5. Customs flagged HS code mismatch on 2 units (they're showing as prototype parts). We'll need serial confirmation. Forwarder = HelixFreight, contact +44 20 5555 0123.

Kate: Heads-up SRE: if we lose those 8 GPUs in eu-west we need to move canaries -> us-west. @Linh can you schedule the reroute? Also finance: we should ask vendor for loaner credits for the downtime window.

Linh: On it. I'll start draining canary traffic at 14:30 UTC and shift test jobs. Expect ~120ms higher tail latency for a few routes. Also watch egress costs — cross-region routing will add ~$200/day while this runs.

ops-bot: [automated] Capacity alert: Dedicated pool eu-west-2 -12 GPUs at 14:00 UTC due to pending RMA. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/pools/eu-west-2

Alex: @Dmitri what's the earliest HelixFreight can clear the customs hold if we provide serials + photos right now? We can accept partial deliveries at depot but need ETA to update provisioning.

Dmitri (Vendor): If serials + photos uploaded within 2 hours, HelixFreight says customs recheck could clear in 24-36h. If you want immediate depot acceptance (split AWB), we can request express release but there is a surcharge and limited slots.

Maria: Please request express release and send cost estimate. Also confirm which 2 units had HS mismatch (we need to mark those in our asset system).

Dmitri (Vendor): HS mismatch = serials SNL-99822, SNL-99823. I'll push express release request and get a quote.

Kate: We should also ask Procurement to open a short-term loaner request. If vendor can't guarantee <48h, authorize 16 loaner GPUs from our loaner pool for eu-west for 3 days. @Maria can you coordinate?

Maria: Yep, initiating loaner request now. If vendor covers brokerage surcharge we can accept split acceptance. Also open RMA claim referencing invoice 8742 and insurance case 9933.

Dmitri (Vendor): Quote for express release + split depot acceptance = EUR 4,200 (includes forwarder surcharge + customs facilitation). Can provide PO to HelixFreight if Redwood approves.

Alex: Can we get credit for downtime instead? Hoodie numbers: we lost ~15% capacity, projected revenue-risk small but ops impact high. @Kate do you want vendor credit vs cover surcharge?

Kate: Prefer vendor covers surcharge (faster) + small credit for downtime. I'll loop Finance after we get formal invoice. For now approve PO up to EUR 5k if it reduces time to clear. :thumbsup:

Linh: Quick note — if we accept split AWB and depot acceptance, update firewall egress ACLs so depot management can pull KV cache snapshots during handover. Otherwise we'll get cold-start costs.

Dmitri (Vendor): Got it. I'll push the express release and upload the missing manifest PDF + photos to the shared folder. Expect docs in ~30m.

Maria: Once docs are up I'll ping HelixFreight and Customs broker. Also tagging @ops-bot to post depot acceptance window when scheduled.

ops-bot: [automated] Depot booking requested: eu-depot-ams - requested window 2026-03-23 09:00-12:00 CET. Pending confirmation from forwarder.

Alex: Plan for now: 1) Dmitri uploads manifest + photos by 15:00 UTC; 2) Maria coordinates express release and depot acceptance; 3) Kate approves up to EUR 5k PO for surcharge and requests vendor credit; 4) Linh reroutes canaries at 14:30 UTC.

Dmitri (Vendor): Docs uploaded: https://files.helixfreight.com/rma/MAN-8742.pdf Photos: https://img.host/rma/8742.zip

Maria: Confirmed receipt. Pinged HelixFreight & customs broker. They've started the expedited clearance workflow.

Kate: I'll start the finance note. If vendor proposes credit, send proposal to procurement@redwood.ai with breakdown.

Alex: Thanks all. @Dmitri please keep the AWB updates coming and flag any changes to ETA — we need to keep rollout planner updated.

Dmitri (Vendor): Will do. Apologies for the gap — pushing to clear ASAP.

Maria: Closing loop: HelixFreight confirmed provisional release contingent on serial verification. Customs ETA ~ tomorrow 18:00 CET if no other flags. Will update thread. :thinking_face:
